text:
Maya Patel: saw a spike of soft-429s for the ML-preview pool around 11:03 UTC, correlates with a big drop in avg batch size and a switch in kernel hints.
Arun Singh: timeline? was this after the overnight kernel autotune rollout?
Maya Patel: yes, we flipped kernel-hint v3 -> v4 at 10:58 and then ~11:02 the admission-meter reported oscillation. logs attached (snippet).
Lucas Chen: quick log snippet?
Maya Patel: ```
[11:01:57] admit: lane=short-token prefetch_credit=8 -> 2
[11:02:01] kernel_hint: selected=wavkernel_v4 batch_est=4 latency_est=62ms
[11:02:01] kvcache: evict=prefix-lease worker=rt-12
[11:02:05] admit: lane=short-token prefetch_credit=0 soft_reject=1 code=429
```
Priya Kapoor: interesting that kv evictions lined up. Could be prefetch-credit oscillation starving the KV warm path so batches shrink which then triggers the low-latency kernel, then a handoff causes latency spikes -> more rejections.
Zoe: @Arun any idea if v4 kernel has a different warm-start behavior w.r.t. KV mapping?
Arun Singh: v4 added an aggressive fused-attn path that performs worse when past-kv locality is low. It assumes good cache hit rates. If prefetch credits drop, effective cache hit metric drops and v4 can regress a lot.
Lucas Chen: so chain: credit drop -> kv miss -> kernel picks v4 (wrong choice) -> latency up -> queue backpressure -> more credit drops = oscillation.
Maya Patel: exactly. telemetry shows KV_HIT_RATE short-lane went from 0.78 -> 0.41 in 35s window.
Priya Kapoor: do we have per-lane smoothing on prefetch credits? I thought credit allocator had an EMA with alpha=0.5 currently.
Arun Singh: it's pretty reactive. We debated alpha=0.7 for stability but reverted for responsiveness. That reactivity might be the issue here.
Zoe: proposal: add two short mitigations first: 1) increase prefetch-credit smoothing alpha -> 0.8 for 10m for the experiment, 2) add simple hysteresis in kernel-hint: require two consecutive metric ticks showing hit_rate<0.6 before switching to v4.
Lucas Chen: also add a temporary soft-floor on prefetch_credit for short-token lane at 2 credits — prevents complete starvation.
Priya Kapoor: agree. We should also record the batch_size distribution and kernel selection sequence in the 30s before/after to prove causality.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: prefetch-smoothing-alpha=0.8 -> canary on ML-preview at 11:40 UTC, duration 15m.
Maya Patel: canary started. baseline: soft-429 rate 1.8% over last 10m.
Arun Singh: I'll add the hysteresis guard in kernel-hint controller, toggle via feature flag f_kernel_hysteresis. will push a patch.
Lucas Chen: small experiment plan: a) 15m canary smoothing only, b) 15m canary smoothing + kernel hysteresis + credit floor; measure: soft-429 rate, p50/p95 latency, kv_hit_rate, avg_batch_size.
Priya Kapoor: thresholds: success if soft-429 drops 50% and p95 latency drops >= 10% for short-lane. If not, rollback and collect heap of perf traces.
Zoe: also add a perf trace sampler to capture kernel handoffs (trace_id + kernel_before->kernel_after + batch_size) for any request that experiences a kernel change within 200ms.
Maya Patel: canary results: smoothing-only reduced oscillation amplitude but still had occasional spikes; combined change removed the repeated 30s oscillation, soft-429 down to 0.6%. p95 down ~12%. KV_HIT_RATE stabilized ~0.72.
Arun Singh: good signal. next steps: tune alpha in prom-experiment: try 0.85 and maybe adaptive alpha that decays responsiveness when oscillation energy is high.
Lucas Chen: long term: kernel hinter should consider predicted kv_hit_rate as a first-class input and penalize kernels that degrade more when hit_rate is low. Also consider a fallback budget: if kernel handoff yields increased latency, automatically prefer previous kernel for N minutes.
Priya Kapoor: add to backlog: 1) adaptive-alpha allocator, 2) kernel hint hysteresis baseline, 3) per-lane minimum prefetch credit config, 4) richer telemetry for kernel handoff traces.
Maya Patel: filing follow-up ticket with slices + raw traces. Anyone want to pair on the kernel-hysteresis impl? Arun + Lucas volunteer.
Arun Singh: I'll open the PR and link the canary dashboards.
Zoe: thanks all. marking incident as triaged. :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: tl;dr: aggressive smoothing + kernel hysteresis + credit floor fixed the prefetch-credit -> kv miss -> bad kernel handoff oscillation.
